खच् खच्, cl. 1. 9. P. खचति and खच्-
ञाति, चखाच, खचितुम्, to come forth,
appear; to be born again; to cause prosperity; to
purify; cl. 10. P. खचयति, -यितुम्, to fasten,
bind, set.

खचित, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened, joined; mixed,
[]
blended, combined; inlaid, set, studded, (used in
comp., e. g. मणि-खचित, inlaid with jewels.)
